Partition into 24 chambers gives the displayed negative fourfold response integral. Metzler positivity yields strict sign and all completely-monotone derivatives. Dominated convergence of three rescaled gaps gives the inverse-cubic coefficient; matching two-point inputs guarantees all network two-point covariances agree. Exact symbolic kernel integration and an independent Markov-generator solver pass 26 assertions, including the sign-changing boundary witness. The proof, rather than finite tests, covers all finite dimensions.

value.rationale: All finite connected overdamped harmonic sites and all nonnegative reachable observables possess a sign-definite non-Gaussian statistic invisible to the full two-time covariance matrix. A strict complete-monotonicity law and sharp rate exponent make this physically measurable across flipping rates, while a positive signed-probe counterexample shows the cooperative restriction is necessary. The statement is a structural all-network theorem with exact limits, not just evaluating one low-order moment at an arbitrary parameter.
